gen.title: Spent Fuel Handling From Pool to Disposal
gen.orderNote: Stages follow the handling order from pool storage toward disposal

steps.label: spent fuel pools
steps.quote: All U.S. nuclear power plants store spent nuclear fuel in "spent fuel pools."
steps.orderHint: Put steps in order fuel is stored and moved

steps.label: shield the radiation and cool
steps.quote: The water is typically about 40 feet deep and serves both to shield the radiation and cool the rods.
steps.orderHint: Put steps in order fuel is stored and moved

steps.label: dry cask
steps.quote: As the pools near capacity, utilities move some of the older spent fuel into “dry cask” storage.
steps.orderHint: Put steps in order fuel is stored and moved

steps.label: cooled at least five years
steps.quote: Fuel is typically cooled at least five years in the pool before transfer to cask.
steps.orderHint: Put steps in order fuel is stored and moved

steps.label: permanent disposal
steps.quote: Spent fuel storage at power plant sites is considered temporary, with the ultimate goal being permanent disposal.
steps.orderHint: Put steps in order fuel is stored and moved
